name: dot-panel
description: An AGPL framework and agent skills for creating and maintaining your own private, customizable Dot Panel in ChatGPT Sites.

interface.longDescription: Dot Panel gives your dot a private, customizable dashboard for project updates, calendar events, usage tracking, and questions you can answer with a tap. Your dot guides setup and helps you create widgets and layouts that fit how you work.
defaultPrompt: Set up my private Dot Panel with the modules I choose
Customize a widget while preserving my saved layouts
Set up optional local usage tracking for my own panel
